title: Veteran analyst says S&P 500 could climb to 8,250 in 2026 - Yahoo Finance
text: Veteran analyst says S&P 500 could climb to 8,250 in 2026 Nauman Khan May 12, 2026 1 min read CL=F +0.79% This article first appeared on GuruFocus . Ed Yardeni raised his year-end 2026 S&P 500 target to 8,250 from 7,700, saying stronger earnings and a resilient U.S. consumer could keep the market advancing, according to a CNBC interview. Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, said first-quarter results and analysts' faster earnings revisions reinforced his view. He said the backdrop still looks constructive despite tariff worries, geopolitical tensions and Brent crude near $110 a barrel. Warning! GuruFocus has detected 6 Warning Signs with SNDK. Is SPY fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator. Yardeni pointed to retiring baby boomers as a key support for spending, noting their large net worth and lower mortgage burdens. He also said corporate cash flow and profits are at record levels, while wage pressures have eased as labor supply and demand have come back into balance. Yardeni said productivity gains, including from artificial intelligence, could help extend what he called a modern roaring twenties. He added that policy stimulus from both parties may continue to support growth, even as higher oil prices and inflation remain risks. He said that could help corporate profits and limit pullbacks somewhat. Terms and Privacy Policy Privacy Dashboard More Info
